1972.notes: Youngstown Codified Ordinances § 181.04 (Effective period and purposes; American Legal Publishing) narrates the rate history as 'the one and one-half percent (1 1/2%) ... representing the prior imposed income tax', 'the remaining tax increase of one-half percent (1/2%) ... over and above the current income tax of one and one-half percent', 'the remaining tax increase of one-quarter of one percent (1/4%) ... over and above the current income tax of two percent (2%)' and 'the remaining tax increase of one-half of one percent ... over and above the current income tax of two and one-quarter percent (2 1/4%)' (the last approved by voters 11-5-02, levied from January 1, 2003 per § 181.03); § 181.01 cites Ord. 81-342 approved by voters 9-8-81. So 1.5% was the rate from before 1970 until the first increase, voted September 8, 1981; the ACIR editions print 1.5% at December 31, 1970 and 1971, July 1, 1973, July 1, 1976 and October 1, 1979. No document for 1972 itself. The 2% rate took effect September 15, 1981 (see 1981).

1981.notes: Secondary source (Youngstown Vindicator, 'Victory Margin 2 1/2 to 1', front page, and 'City Income Tax Boost Passed; Will Take Effect Next Tuesday', p. 6, September 9, 1981, via Google News Archive): the one-half percent increase passed by voters on September 8, 1981 brings the total city income tax to 2 percent, up from 1 1/2 percent; the city would start collecting it the following Tuesday (September 15, 1981) once the Mahoning County Board of Elections certified the vote. Year-end rate recorded: 1.5% applied before mid-September 1981. Single secondary source; consistent with Codified Ordinances sec. 181.01 (Ord. 81-342, approved by voters 9-8-81) and ACIR's 2.0% for 1983.

1982.notes: Secondary source (Youngstown Vindicator, 'Victory Margin 2 1/2 to 1' and 'City Income Tax Boost Passed; Will Take Effect Next Tuesday', September 9, 1981, via Google News Archive): the city income tax rose from 1 1/2 to 2 percent from Tuesday, September 15, 1981. Codified Ordinances sec. 181.04 records the next increase as one-quarter percent over the 2% rate (2.25% in this file from 1997), and ACIR lists 2.0% for 1983, so 2% was in force throughout 1982. Single secondary source for the effective date.
